_README: Coordinates and exposure sectors are FIRST-PASS values derived from the itinerary text and general knowledge of the Aeolians. Every entry with "verified": false must be checked against satellite imagery and a pilot book before the fleet relies on it. An exposure sector is the arc of compass bearings (degrees true, [from, to] clockwise) that wind and swell arrive from when that berth becomes uncomfortable or untenable. A wrong sector produces a confidently wrong shelter recommendation.

portorosa.name: Portorosa Marina
portorosa.shelter_note: Fully enclosed artificial marina basin - all-round shelter.

lipari_pignataro.name: Porto Pignataro
lipari_pignataro.shelter_note: Largest harbour in the Aeolians and the safest port in the group. Breakwatered; only a hard easterly sets any swell inside.

lipari_marina_lunga.name: Marina Lunga / Porto Lipari
lipari_marina_lunga.shelter_note: Town quay on the east coast. Fuel and water available. Open to the NE-SE quadrant and to ferry wash.

lipari_valle_muria.name: Valle Muria
lipari_valle_muria.shelter_note: Beautiful SW-facing bay, very safe anchoring in northerlies and easterlies. Untenable in anything from S through W.

panarea_sanpietro.name: San Pietro buoy field
panarea_sanpietro.shelter_note: Main buoy field off the port town on the east coast. Exposed to the NE-SE.

panarea_drautto.name: Drautto buoy field
panarea_drautto.shelter_note: Buoy field and anchoring south of San Pietro. Exposed to the E-SE.

panarea_zimmari.name: Cala Zimmari
panarea_zimmari.shelter_note: Black sand bay on the SE corner. Good in northerlies, rolly from the E and S.

panarea_milazzese.name: Baia Milazzese
panarea_milazzese.shelter_note: South-facing bay under the Bronze Age headland. Best shelter on Panarea in a northerly.

stromboli_gabbiano.name: Marina del Gabbiano
stromboli_gabbiano.shelter_note: Reserved buoys 600 m north of Scari on the east coast. DO NOT ANCHOR - the bottom is very rocky. Open to the whole northern-through-southeastern arc.

filicudi_porto.name: Filicudi Porto
filicudi_porto.shelter_note: Small port with limited dockage and mooring buoys on the NE side. Exposed N through ESE.

filicudi_pecorini.name: Pecorini a Mare
filicudi_pecorini.shelter_note: Picturesque sheltered bay on the southern coast. The lee-side alternative when Filicudi Porto is exposed.

salina_santamarina.name: Porto Santa Marina Salina
salina_santamarina.shelter_note: Floating piers and mooring buoys on the east coast. Exposed to the NE-SE.

salina_rinella.name: Rinella
salina_rinella.shelter_note: Scenic and protected anchorage on the south side with a dinghy dock. The lee-side alternative to Santa Marina in an easterly.

stromboli_sciara.name: Sciara del Fuoco
stromboli_sciara.note: Night viewing position on the NW side - the fleet sails here after dark to watch lava reach the sea.

salina_pollara.name: Pollara Bay
salina_pollara.note: Sunset and diving spot; Il Postino filming location.

filicudi_la_canna.name: La Canna
filicudi_la_canna.note: 71 m volcanic pinnacle rising from the sea off the NW coast.

legs.label: Portorosa → Lipari
legs.note: First passage of the trip, out of the Golfo di Patti and north to the archipelago.

legs.label: Lipari → Stromboli (optional)
legs.note: Monday-night alternative to Panarea. Plan the return to Panarea for Tuesday.

legs.label: Panarea → Filicudi
legs.note: Longest passage of the trip - the full width of the archipelago, passing north of Salina.

legs.label: Filicudi → Salina
legs.note: Back east to Salina for the final group dinner.

legs.label: Salina → Portorosa
legs.note: Return passage. Hard arrival deadline of 16:00 - work backwards from it when picking a departure window.
